description: Upload paths (contracts/schemas/upload_manifest.schema.json files[].path pattern): what the mobile may upload, test-relative. The server stores only these (server-main uploads::valid_upload_path), so a manifest can never name a file outside the test's folder. `base` (a subset of valid): the files the server still takes while it holds a device's upload away from home (contracts/upload/README.md, server-main uploads::is_base_path).
